description: ADDITIVE permission set for Screen Share widget windows (registry kind 'vnc'). Both the base `panel-vnc` label and parameterized `panel-vnc-*` instance labels are covered. Scoped to just this kind — not the shared panels.json — because vnc_connect opens a loopback WebSocket-to-raw-TCP bridge to an arbitrary host:port; no other panel kind should hold a raw outbound TCP proxy. The panel-* capability still supplies window movement.
